title: The Penguin Dictionary of Literary Terms and Literary Theory

vibeProfile.oneLine: A comprehensive dictionary of literary terms and theory.

summary: This comprehensive Penguin dictionary defines the terms of both traditional literary study and modern literary theory, from classical rhetoric to structuralism, feminism and postmodernism. Wide-ranging and clearly written, it covers forms, genres, movements and critical concepts across world literature. A thorough and reliable reference, it is a valued companion for students navigating the often bewildering language of literature and theory alike.
whyReadIt: A thorough, reliable dictionary of literary terms and theory. A trusted companion for the language of criticism.
